deepseekHarness.executable.markdownDescription: DSH executable. Leave empty to use a source checkout when nested inside deepseek-harness, otherwise `dsh` from PATH. This is a per-machine path, so the setting is machine-scoped: Settings Sync never carries it to another host, and — unlike a workspace-overridable setting — a repository cannot redirect it by shipping a `.vscode/settings.json`. Set it separately on each host.

deepseekHarness.arguments.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to DSH. The default starts the official Cordis Web profile on an OS-assigned loopback port.

deepseekHarness.autoStart.description: Start DSH when the sidebar first opens.

deepseekHarness.reuseExistingRuntime.description: Look for an existing DSH Web runtime on 127.0.0.1:3080 when no custom executable or arguments are configured. Authenticated runtimes prompt you to connect with their launch URL or start a separate managed runtime. A service that answers without its launch token is never adopted: 127.0.0.1 is reachable by every local user on a shared host.

deepseekHarness.rememberExternalRuntime.markdownDescription: Offer to remember a runtime connected with its launch URL so later windows can attach. The authentication URL is stored in host/account/DSH-home-local private storage (`0600` on POSIX), outside VS Code profiles, and is never logged, shown or synced. A saved runtime is attach-only: this extension never installs plugins, writes settings or credentials, or stops it. A failed connection retains the record and reports an error. Use DeepSeek Harness: Forget the Saved Runtime to remove that record explicitly. Disable this setting to connect per window without the offer.

deepseekHarness.reuseAcrossWindows.markdownDescription: Share one managed DSH runtime on the same host, OS account and DSH_HOME, including across VS Code profiles. History search and Schedule remain available. Launch arguments, DSH version, runtime-host protocol and launcher environment must match. The creating window can close while other windows continue. The last normal exit stops DSH. On Linux Remote–SSH, each window is also bound to its verified VS Code Server process. After all valid extension hosts exit, the helper checks every 5 seconds and starts cleanup after a 30-second grace period; an unresponsive DSH is force-terminated after 4 seconds. SSH disconnections follow VS Code's remote.SSH.reconnectionGraceTime; this is not a promise to keep running after a normal close. The helper does not restart DSH automatically. Restart Runtime can replace an incompatible recorded managed runtime, with confirmation if other windows use it. Reconnect only reconnects this window. Keep autonomous debugging disabled for shared mode. Reload after changing this setting. See the README for cleanup limits and upgrade steps.

deepseekHarness.autonomousDebugging.markdownDescription: Expose this workspace's native VS Code debugger to DSH. The bridge belongs to one VS Code window and cannot safely control other windows. Disable autonomous debugging for a shared runtime, or explicitly disable deepseekHarness.reuseAcrossWindows to use a dedicated debugging runtime.

deepseekHarness.startupTimeout.description: Milliseconds allowed for each shared-runtime operation or startup wait, and for a new DSH process to report its local Web URL. A timeout does not stop another window's runtime.

deepseekHarness.searchBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the runtime's web search, for a host that cannot reach the public API. Include the version path — the search plugin appends `/messages` — for example `https://host/anthropic/v1`. Left empty, the runtime keeps its own default. DSH only accepts this variable from the process that launches it, so it cannot be set in the runtime's `.env`; this extension provides it. Per-machine, so Settings Sync never carries it to another host.

deepseekHarness.enableHistorySearch.markdownDescription: Enable server-side message history search in managed DSH Web runtimes (0.2.0-rc.2+). Creates an ephemeral SQLite index on the first search. Restart DSH to apply. Configure session-query in your own profile instead when using a custom or external runtime.

deepseekHarness.enableSchedule.markdownDescription: Mount the official Schedule service in a standard managed DSH Web runtime (0.2.0-rc.2+) so the sidebar can list reminders and delivery history. Restart DSH to apply. Leave disabled when your custom profile already mounts Schedule, and configure external runtimes separately.
